plan.factor: signed low-speed base initial-state regularization only
plan.scope: fixed-arm native ROS numerical SIL; NOT Gazebo or physical robot
plan.capture_note: exact ROS1 message identity; callback entry is not network arrival; diagnostic I/O can perturb subsequent timing

limitations: 单seed静态诊断SIL；OFF/ON闭环请求可能不同，不是同一冻结输入的因果配对。
同步诊断写入/flush会扰动后续周期时序；本实验不是速度benchmark，也不证明动态或硬件安全。
只以序列化hash+seq+纳秒stamp+frames关联状态；禁止最近CSV/近时刻替代精确身份。
callback-entry不是网络到达时刻；capture_mono/capture_sim才是C++事件发生时刻，mono/sim可能是延迟flush时刻。
缺失或歧义为null/未知，空证据不算完整链；同一payload重复回调不推断唯一收包时刻。
kernel返回0、验证成功、最终命令发布与非零物理运动是不同事实；有效性字段不是安全认证。
backend快照/已有静态10cm评估仅作同一冻结输入诊断；报告不重跑规划器或改变碰撞门限。

coupling_experiment.engineering_scope: additional projected qualification/soft cost only; retain native 3D, self-collision, wheel and long-horizon dynamic guards; not full dynamic feasibility equivalence and not an endpoint-stagnation fix
coupling_experiment.scope: fixed-arm native ROS numerical SIL; no hardware drivers or Gazebo
coupling_experiment.state_scope: fixed arm; base raw/processed/native boundary/epoch/exact MPPI input
coupling_experiment.capture_timing_note: synchronous diagnostic I/O; not a performance comparison

audit.outcome_policy: goal/collision/navigation timeout all retained; only setup, crash or contradicted interface invalidates

phase_integrity.nesting: strict native request/stage stack; stages are nested, never summed twice

reference_chain_integrity.clock_note: source ROS event times used; observer tail mono is never treated as MPPI receipt

trial_result.scope: native ROS algorithm SIL, not Gazebo/real vehicle

native_reference_audit.scope: reference integration verification, NOT a performance comparison or hardware acceptance

advisory_freeze.interpretation: advisory controller-clock hold is not MPPI stop; commands are separate from measured motion
advisory_freeze.matching: exact consumed revision/hash and same native start stamp; latest advisory and odom age <0.2s

outcome.scope: native ROS algorithm SIL, not Gazebo/real vehicle
